alsoTry.name: Jägerstube
alsoTry.note: The hotel's regional restaurant, also run by Boris Rommel's kitchen, open daily for lunch and dinner

bookingOpens: By phone, by email (hotel@schlosshotel-friedrichsruhe.de) or through the hotel's enquiry form. Open for dinner Thursday to Saturday, 6.30pm to 10.30pm, with last orders at 8.30pm.
cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the booking; later cancellations and no-shows are charged €150 per person.
groups: The Chef's Table room, looking into the kitchen through a glass wall, takes up to 8 guests; booked by phone, price on request.
